Zoe (People Ops): FYI we've rolled a small handbook patch this morning around two items: Certification Reimbursement workflow + Professional Development stipends. Read: https://redwood.internal/handbook/learning-benefits. TL;DR: cert reimbursements now require completion of the new "Essentials: Compliance & Finance" micromodule and an e-signed benefits attestation prior to reimbursement; PD stipend moves to calendar-quarter allocations (max $400/quarter) instead of annual front-loaded credits. Managers: please confirm eligible headcount and any approved exceptions in the tracker by Mon 2026-07-06. Tracker: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/pd-stipend-tracker. Claim form: https://redwood.internal/forms/pd-claims. Quick export if you need team CSV: `hrcli team-export --team "<team-name>" --fields email,payroll_id`.

Anil (Eng Manager): Quick Q — if someone completed a cert in May but only now files, are retroactive claims allowed?

Zoe (People Ops): Retro claims accepted up to 90 days after course completion. Please mark the form notes field with "retro-claim" and tag @Fiona (Benefits) for expedited review. Beyond 90 days, you'll need an exception and to include manager justification.

Fiona (Benefits): Payroll note: reimbursements under $250 processed as non-taxable reimbursement in US payroll where allowed; >$250 may be taxable depending on local regs. GL codes: PD stipend 7405-PD, Certifications 7410-CERT. For non-USD claims attach an exchange rate source or use the bank rate on transaction date. If claim >$750 total annually, CC finance@redwood.ai for pre-approval.

Eve (IC): Are contractors eligible for the PD stipend? We have a long-term contractor who asks.

Zoe (People Ops): Contractors are not eligible for the stipend. Fixed-term employees on payroll are eligible and will receive pro-rated amounts for partial quarters. If you think a contractor should be made an exception (rare), add a ticket to the people-ops queue and ping me.

onboarding-bot: Attestation created for Eve  ts=2610001241  url=https://redwood.internal/attestations/2610001241

Omar (HRBP): Performance-cycle overlap question: will completion of the micromodule be a gating item for managers during mid-year calibration?

Zoe (People Ops): Good call — training completion is required to process reimbursement and will be visible in the training tracker, but we are not tying it to performance ratings. Managers should confirm attestations in the HRIS before approving reimbursements; we'll surface completions in the manager dashboard.

Anil (Eng Manager): Noted. I'll run the export and update the tracker by the deadline. Also, if a cert is company-mandated (e.g., security cert), will the $400/quarter cap apply?

Zoe (People Ops): Company-required certs are exempt from the quarterly cap but still require the attestation; flag those in the form as "company-required" and they'll route to me + finance for direct approval.

Fiona (Benefits): Action items summary: managers confirm tracker by 2026-07-06; employees complete the micromodule + sign attestation before filing; finance will process payroll refunds next cycle; exceptions handled case-by-case.

Eve (IC): Thanks! Finished the micromodule and signed.

Zoe (People Ops): :thumbsup: thanks everyone, ping me for edge cases or if your team's headcount changed after the cutoff.
